mode: zero-shot general VLM, not an image-difference specialist
prompt_policy: Compare the two images in order: image one is BEFORE and image two is AFTER. Describe only the meaningful visual change, including before-to-after direction. Ignore lighting-only variation. If nothing meaningful changed, say so. Use one concise sentence and do not guess details that are not visible.

cases.expected: No depicted object or property changes.
cases.prediction: There is no meaningful visual change between the two images.

cases.expected: A small yellow ball is added on the right.
cases.prediction: A small yellow circle appears to the right of the blue rectangle in the AFTER image, which is absent in the BEFORE image.

cases.expected: The small yellow ball is removed from the right.
cases.prediction: The yellow circle that was present to the right of the blue rectangle in the first image is absent in the second image.

cases.expected: The large car-like object changes from blue to orange.
cases.prediction: The blue rectangle in the first image is replaced by an orange rectangle in the second image.

cases.expected: The green square moves from the left to the right.
cases.prediction: The green square moves from the left side to the right side of the upper portion.

cases.expected: The green square moves from the right to the left.
cases.prediction: The green square moves from the right side to the left side of the upper beige area.

cases.expected: The sign text changes from EXIT to EX1T.
cases.prediction: The AFTER image shows the letter 'T' added to the right of the word 'EXIT' within the box.

cases.expected: No semantic change; the whole scene is brighter.
cases.prediction: The background color above the rectangle changes from light beige to white.

scope: small constructed qualitative diagnostic; not a benchmark or statistical evaluation
